position_note: Field center near both source positions, degrees ICRS. Event searches use 120 arcsec radius. The Gaia lens cross-check uses 1.5 arcsec at the expected 2016 position of the foreground dwarf.

checks.adql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM plc.data WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',lensalpha,lensdelta),CIRCLE('ICRS',300.20910,36.49980,0.03333333)) OR 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',obalpha,obdelta),CIRCLE('ICRS',300.20910,36.49980,0.03333333))

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM plc2.data WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',lens_ra,lens_dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',300.20910,36.49980,0.03333333)) OR 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ob_ra,ob_dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',300.20910,36.49980,0.03333333))

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM plc3.data WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',lens_ra,lens_dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',300.20910,36.49980,0.03333333)) OR 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ob_ra,ob_dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',300.20910,36.49980,0.03333333))
